1266.reason: A partner-built reference deployment template, with no change to an AWS service itself.

1270.reason: One more operating system version is added to those an existing benchmark rules package covers.

1295.reason: Three finding types join the existing detection catalogue automatically, with no new controls or interface.

1343.reason: The managed operations service adds a second, multi-account foundation design with managed shared services as an onboarding choice.
